label: Katana checks
description: One record per 5-minute check that changed something in Swell, or that continues on the next run

source.description: sales_orders: status and tracking of sales orders; inventory: stock of items that moved

status.description: running: the check continues on the next run (out of time or a retryable error); completed: done

changed.description: Swell orders or stock levels updated in this check

not_found.description: Sales orders without a Swell order, or SKUs not in Swell

failed.description: Changes that couldn't be applied in this check

report.description: Swell stock levels changed by this check, one row per product or variant (up to 2000 rows)

variant.description: Swell variant name, empty for a product without variants

change.description: Stock change in Swell (new level minus old level)

report_rows.description: Swell stock levels changed by this check, including any beyond the 2000 rows kept

date_cursor.description: The check reads Katana changes made after this time

date_pass_started.description: When the check started; the next check reads changes from here (minus a short overlap)

page.description: Katana page a running check continues at
